## Joseki

This is basically the famous Great Slope Joseki (aka Taisha), except Black has an extra stone at <A:L17>. Once attractive and complicated, it has now been reduced and simplified because of AI. (See [Jiang Weijie, commenting a Samsung Cup game: Shin Jinseo v. Xie Erhao](https://gochn2en.net/wp/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Sumsang_cup_Shin_Xie.pdf).)
